title: Tiger cub waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M78 72 Q92 70 90 56 Q89 50 84 52 Q86 62 76 66 Z" fill="#E8862E" stroke="#F5B05A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M89 57 Q90 55 87 54" stroke="#4A2A12" stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="76" rx="20" ry="17" fill="#F08A24"/>
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="80" rx="12" ry="11" fill="#FFD9A0"/>
  <path d="M40 68 q6 -4 12 0" stroke="#4A2A12" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
  <path d="M62 65 q6 -3 10 2" stroke="#4A2A12" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="91" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#FFD9A0"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="91" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#FFD9A0"/>
  <path d="M41 90 l0 4 M44 91 l0 4 M47 90 l0 4" stroke="#E8862E" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <path d="M63 90 l0 4 M66 91 l0 4 M69 90 l0 4" stroke="#E8862E" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- waving arm -->
  <path d="M70 70 Q78 60 80 48" stroke="#F08A24" stroke-width="9" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="45" r="7" fill="#FFD9A0"/>
  <circle cx="77" cy="41" r="2.2" fill="#F8B98A"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="39" r="2.2" fill="#F8B98A"/>
  <circle cx="83" cy="41" r="2.2" fill="#F8B98A"/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <path d="M38 74 Q32 78 30 84" stroke="#F08A24" stroke-width="8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="29" cy="86" r="5.5" fill="#FFD9A0"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="26" fill="#F08A24"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="29" cy="22" r="8" fill="#F08A24"/>
  <circle cx="29" cy="22" r="4.5" fill="#FF9AA8"/>
  <circle cx="71" cy="22" r="8" fill="#F08A24"/>
  <circle cx="71" cy="22" r="4.5" fill="#FF9AA8"/>
  <!-- forehead stripes -->
  <path d="M50 20 l0 10" stroke="#4A2A12" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.65"/>
  <path d="M42 22 l-2 9" stroke="#4A2A12" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.65"/>
  <path d="M58 22 l2 9" stroke="#4A2A12" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.65"/>
  <!-- cheek stripes -->
  <path d="M25 40 l7 2 M25 46 l7 0" stroke="#4A2A12" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.65"/>
  <path d="M75 40 l-7 2 M75 46 l-7 0" stroke="#4A2A12" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.65"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="15" ry="11" fill="#FFE6C0"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="41" cy="40" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#3A2410"/>
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="40" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#3A2410"/>
  <circle cx="42.5" cy="38" r="1.8" fill="#FFF6E0"/>
  <circle cx="60.5" cy="38" r="1.8" fill="#FFF6E0"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d="M46 48 h8 l-4 5 z" fill="#FF8FA3"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M50 53 v3 M50 56 q-4 4 -7 1 M50 56 q4 4 7 1" stroke="#8A4A20" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- whisker dots -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="53" r="1" fill="#C57A3A"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="53" r="1" fill="#C57A3A"/>
</svg>
